card.name: Scattered words in label headings and lists
card.fires_on: Short linking words or word starts in drug-label text, such as 'to' after 'hypersensitivity', 'W' at the start of 'Worsening' in section headings, and commas or 'and' inside lists of drugs or conditions. Also a colon or 'a' in Spanish scientific text.

modes.label: Heading starts
modes.description: The first letter of a word like Worsening or Febrile in warning headings or adverse-reaction lists.

modes.label: Linking words in contraindications
modes.description: The word 'to' after 'hypersensitivity' in contraindication bullets.
modes.example: • Known hypersensitivity<< to>> any component of this drug. (

modes.label: Spanish text
modes.description: A colon or the word 'a' in Spanish scientific titles and abstracts.
modes.example: Efecto de una tormenta de nieve sobre la interacción colibríplanta<<:>> los patrones espaciotemporales

card.writes: The promoted tokens suggest a push toward Spanish 'por' and similar words, but the effect is weak and unclear.
card.plain: It fires on small connecting words and word beginnings in warning and contraindication lists, plus some Spanish text.
